chain_words.nuance: wishing for a good outcome without strong certainty
general belief that things will turn out well
feeling sure of one's own ability or judgement
calm, firm certainty that others can notice
fully certain that something is true

explanation: These words all express a sense of expectation or certainty, from mild hope to complete conviction.

usage_notes.difference: 'Hopeful' refers to a wish for a specific outcome; 'optimistic' describes a general outlook that things will turn out well.
